text:
Sam (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — HeliosCloud invited Redwood to their new azure-aurora marketplace region. They asked for a coordinated pilot + SKU mapping and a telemetry billing feed.
Elena (Partnerships): Nice. capacity ask? any certified HW or KMS requirements? :mag:
Sam (Partnerships): Helios proposed initial entitlement: 7 reserved GPUs, burst to 21 for 14 days. They accept Redwood-managed KMS for marketplace but require HSM for enterprise customers. Also want entitlement webhook + marketplace SKU.
Noor (Cloud Ops): 7 reserved is small — we can carve from the eu-az1 nodepool. Need AMI bake and marketplace AMI upload. estimate: 3 days infra + 1 day warm-up.
Cal (SRE): Can we get a 48h capacity hold around soft-launch? We'll run a 24h canary (4h smoke + 20h soak). Need Helios to mirror routing in their marketplace.
Sam (Partnerships): Helios PM says they can hold capacity for 72h if we request. Also asking for joint press cadence: soft-launch -> 10 days -> joint blog. They want a 5-day pre-press embargo.
Helios PM: pinging in — we can grant a 72h hold and provide staging creds for entitlement webhook. Will share billing schema and legal contact.
Elena (Partnerships): dropping the SKU they pasted from partner portal:
```
SKU: redwood-inference.azure-aurora.v1
Plan: reserved-7
Burst: burst-21
BillingFeed: webhook-v1
KMS: redwood-managed-ok / enterprise-hsm
```
Cal (SRE): For webhook we need sample events and a staging endpoint. Helios, can you attach sample payloads?
Helios PM: sample payloads will be in staging pack, sending shortly.
Noor (Cloud Ops): infra checklist: 1) bake AMI 2) push marketplace AMI 3) provision nodepool 4) entitlement mapping 5) LB routing + healthchecks. I can own 1-3. ETA if creds arrive today: 3 business days.
Pri (Legal): For HSM we need an appendix allowing enterprise customers to opt into Helios-managed HSM or customer HSM. I'll draft the HSM appendix + a short DPA addendum. Need Helios legal contact to finalize.
Sam (Partnerships): I'll grab Helios legal contact and staging creds. Cal, can you draft canary runbook and SLI targets?
Cal (SRE): Yep — will post a canary runbook with healthcheck queries and tokenized traffic script. Also want alerted thresholds: p90 < 320ms for local-inference path.
LaunchBot: ticket #PRT-4492 created: "Helios Azure-Aurora Marketplace Onramp" assigned to Sam, Noor, Cal. ETA infra: 3 days.
Noor (Cloud Ops): one risk: Azure sku family mismatch. I'll ask Helios ops for exact GPU SKU (e.g., NCasT4_v3 vs. NVads). If mismatch we need fallback mapping.
Elena (Partnerships): I'll coordinate partner comms and draft the announcement timeline. Sam — please confirm whether Helios wants Redwood to run the first canary or they do it on their side.
Helios PM: we prefer Redwood to run canary against staging SKU while we mirror traffic; Helios ops will validate entitlements.
Pri (Legal): I'll prepare the DPA + HSM appendix and target internal review EOD+2. Sam, DM me Helios legal contact.
Sam (Partnerships): Next steps: Sam to collect Helios legal + staging creds; Noor to open infra PR for AMI bake & nodepool; Cal to draft canary runbook & SLI; Pri to draft legal appendices. Sync Thursday 10:00 CET. Any blockers?
Cal (SRE): only potential blocker is GPU SKU family availability. Noor, please request a 72h capacity hold from Helios ops.
Noor (Cloud Ops): will request hold now and report back.
Elena (Partnerships): if Helios can do the hold we're green to hit the soft-launch window and then the joint blog cadence.
Helios PM: confirmed — hold request approved for 72h. sending staging creds + sample billing events to Sam now.
Sam (Partnerships): thanks all. I'll post creds and Helios legal contact here when I have them and send calendar invite for Thursday sync. :thumbsup:
